en.headline: 368 commits, 25 PRs and 58 issues across 17 repos in 30 days
en.teaser: Most work went into asset-inventory releases and docs tooling, meld-deepresearch's research protocol, and a stream of bug reports filed against OpenCode-ecosystem projects.
en.overview:
### Own repositories

Most of the window's effort went into `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, which was moved through a long run of releases from v1.3.0 to v1.15.0 plus several patches. The early releases made the repository English-first, added paired Chinese docs and a seven-language fixed-string glossary, and split long-form documentation out of the READMEs. Later releases turned documentation rules into automated checks: a PR-triggered docs check, a version-consistency check, a language-claim check that fails when an advertised language has no glossary block, and a reference-integrity check. A release-prep script and a docs-parity gate were added afterwards.

Asset-inventory also received substantive inventory fixes. MCP enumeration previously stopped after one server and was corrected to read every key and assert the row count; `update.ps1` nested-directory handling was repaired; host-command scanning was rewritten to enumerate the app bundle's own registries first. A fifth state marker, broken, was introduced for assets registered in config but not invokable, and security guards were added so that scanned text is treated as evidence rather than instructions. Install guidance moved to `git clone` and later to a one-line skills.sh install.

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` was reworked substantially: profile copy switched to English, a 30-day activity card with a daily automated update workflow was added, the daily report moved to rolling two-hour updates with a date input for manual runs, and CI was upgraded off the deprecated Node 20 runtime. Several fixes made the reported statistics and their breakdowns stay consistent.

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` grew from v0.1.0 to v0.4.0. The releases added a bilingual GitHub Pages landing page, a Chinese README with language switching, validation scripts and CI, a first-class observations evidence type, an explicit rule for sources behind paywalls or bot walls, and a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the gates. v0.3.0 split the single skill into three cooperating skills, including a spreadsheet data-analysis skill adapted from SenseNova-Skills.

### Smaller projects and external contributions

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` reached v1.0.0 and then v1.4.0, adding plan-aware model allocation, a three-part output body with a data appendix, agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, proxy-aware atomic JSON helpers and a failure-mode diagnostic. `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` implemented a skill_management plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions and published 0.1.0-rc.0 and 0.1.0-rc.1 through trusted publishing. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` assembled an AGENTS.md and a knowledge archive covering OpenCode architecture, authentication, Windows path pitfalls and remote branch deletion. `sogeisetsu/myBlog` received three OpenChamber screenshot samples.

Outside their own repositories, the user filed the bulk of the window's issues. Twenty-nine went to `openchamber/openchamber`, covering a stale-save clobber in the Behavior settings, missing auto-update manifests in v2.0.1, orphaned MCP child processes after deleting a multi-run, a context-panel breakdown bar that always shows zero, browser captures exported at 1x on high-DPI displays, and the inability to unlink an agent-linked issue or PR. Twelve issues went to `anomalyco/opencode`, mostly about MiMo model image handling on the Go endpoint and missing `x-opencode-session` headers. Compatibility reports were also filed against `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator`, `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`, `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills`, `vercel-labs/skills` and `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`. A pull request to `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` proposed listing asset-inventory.

### Data caveats

No days in the window are missing data. Dates from 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-01 were reconstructed through GitHub Search and are approximate: star counts are unavailable for those days and the release data covers only the user's own repositories.

Documentation rules became automated checks for versions, language claims and reference integrity. Inventory fixes covered MCP enumeration, `update.ps1`, registry-first host-command scanning and a new broken state marker.

99 own commits plus 331 automated commits, 5 issues and no PRs or releases. The profile page gained a 30-day activity card with a daily automated update workflow, later changed to two-hour rolling updates with a manual date input. Copy was switched to English, CI moved to checkout/setup-node v7, LF endings were enforced and statistics/breakdown mismatches were fixed. A temporary smoke-test issue was opened and closed.

76 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs or issues, and 4 releases. Work produced v0.1.0 through v0.4.0: a bilingual Pages landing page, a Chinese README with a language switch, validation scripts and CI, an observations evidence type, rules for blocked sources, a three-skill family including a spreadsheet analysis skill, and the `meld.py` CLI wrapping the six gates.

No commits, PRs or releases; 29 issues were filed. Reports covered a stale-save clobber of AGENTS.md, missing latest.yml/latest-mac.yml in v2.0.1, orphaned MCP child processes after deleting a multi-run, a context breakdown bar stuck at 0%, 1x browser captures on 200% displays, an unlinkable agent-linked issue, a lost thinking level on model switch and dropped attachments for text-only models. Ideas discussions covered session statistics, extension SDK access and encrypted relay keys.

24 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs or issues, and 4 releases. The skill reached v1.0.0 with plan-aware allocation, then v1.1.0 restructured output into a three-part body with a data appendix, v1.3.0 added discover-agents and snapshot-summary scripts, and v1.4.0 added proxy-aware atomic JSON helpers, richer agent discovery and new flags.

14 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs, issues or releases. The repository started with an initial commit and then assembled an AGENTS.md plus a knowledge archive covering OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and authentication, Windows path pitfalls, oh-my-opencode-slim testing notes and remote branch deletion checks. Stale conclusions in the knowledge files were corrected.

13 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs or issues, and no releases. A skill_management plugin was implemented with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, accompanied by spec revisions and feasibility notes. Versions 0.1.0-rc.0 and 0.1.0-rc.1 were published through CI trusted publishing to validate the OIDC configuration, and line endings were normalized to LF.

No commits, PRs or releases; 12 issues were filed. Reports focused on MiMo-V2.6-Flash and MiMo-V2.5 advertising image input on the Go endpoint while every image returned HTTP 400, stale image reads after several images in one session, subagent failures with model_coming_soon, a missing Windows desktop CLI entry point, and a tinyfish websearch provider returning HTTP 400.

No commits or releases; 8 PRs and 4 issues were recorded. The PRs fixed CRLF acceptance in frontmatter validation, platform-specific browser opening for review URLs, disposal of review servers on plugin unload, and robustness in eval parsing, aggregation and install. Issues covered OpenCode V2 plugin load failures and dist rebuilds inlining dependencies.
3 own commits, no automated commits, and no PRs, issues or releases. The only work was adding OpenChamber capture samples: a desktop 1440x900 JPEG, a 1:1 panel-region PNG and a mobile 390x844 JPEG.
No commits, PRs or releases; 2 issues. A bug report described reflect --sessions querying legacy V1 tables and returning zero sessions on OpenCode V2.

No commits, PRs or releases; 2 issues. A report noted that OpenCode detection and the skill install path point at ~/.opencode while OpenCode uses ~/.config/opencode, with a follow-up asking for a v2 skills path fix and an mcp target.
No commits, PRs or releases; 2 issues. Both were listing requests asking for indexing of sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker and sogeisetsu/asset-inventory.
No commits, PRs or releases; 1 issue. It reported OpenCode V2 compatibility problems with SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions.
No commits, PRs or releases; 1 issue. It requested making the harness extensible to OpenCode and Pi and considering exposing it via MCP.
No commits, issues or releases; 1 PR. The pull request proposed adding sogeisetsu/asset-inventory to the curated skills list.
No own commits, 5 automated commits, and no PRs, issues or releases. Bot-driven commits were the only activity recorded in this repository during the window.

zh.headline: 30 天内在 17 个仓库完成 368 次提交、25 个 PR 和 58 个 issue
zh.teaser: 主要精力放在 asset-inventory 的连续发版与文档工具、meld-deepresearch 的研究协议，以及针对 OpenCode 生态项目的一批缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
### 自有仓库

本期大部分工作集中在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`，从 v1.3.0 一路发到 v1.15.0，中间还夹着多个补丁版本。早期版本把仓库改为英文优先，补充了配套中文文档和七语种固定字符串词表，并把长篇文档从 README 中拆出。后续版本把文档规则变成自动检查：PR 触发的 docs 检查、版本一致性检查、语言声明检查（声称支持的语言若没有词表块就失败）、引用完整性检查。之后又加入发布准备脚本和文档对齐门禁。

asset-inventory 的清单逻辑也有实质修复。MCP 枚举原先只列出一个服务器就停下，现改为读取每个 key 并校验行数；`update.ps1` 的嵌套目录处理被修正；主机命令扫描改为优先枚举应用自带的命令注册表。新增第五种状态标记 broken，用于配置中已注册但无法调用的资产，并加入安全护栏，让扫描到的文本只作为证据而不被当作指令执行。安装方式先改为 `git clone`，后又提供 skills.sh 一行安装。

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 改动较大：个人简介文案改为英文，新增带每日自动更新工作流的近 30 天活动卡片，日报改为每两小时滚动更新并支持手动指定日期，CI 升级以摆脱已弃用的 Node 20 运行时。另有若干修复让统计数字与其拆分保持一致。

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 从 v0.1.0 发展到 v0.4.0。各版本加入双语 GitHub Pages 落地页、带语言切换的中文 README、校验脚本与 CI、一等公民的 observations 证据类型、针对付费墙和机器人拦截来源的明确规则，以及包裹各道门禁的 `meld.py` 精简命令行。v0.3.0 把单一技能拆成三个协作技能，其中一个是从 SenseNova-Skills 改编的表格数据分析技能。

### 较小项目与外部贡献

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 先到 v1.0.0，再到 v1.4.0，加入按套餐分配模型、三段式输出加数据附录、agent 发现与快照摘要脚本、支持代理的原子 JSON 工具和失败模式诊断。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 实现了带 list、inspect、disable、enable 的 skill_management 插件，并通过可信发布发出 0.1.0-rc.0 和 0.1.0-rc.1。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 整理了 AGENTS.md 和知识归档，内容涉及 OpenCode 架构、认证、Windows 路径坑和远程分支删除。`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 新增三张 OpenChamber 截图样例。

在自有仓库之外，本期 issue 主要由此用户提交。其中 29 个提交给 `openchamber/openchamber`，涉及 Behavior 设置页外部修改后的静默覆盖、v2.0.1 缺少自动更新清单、删除多运行后残留 MCP 子进程、上下文面板拆分条始终为 0%、高 DPI 下浏览器截图只有 1x 分辨率，以及无法解除 agent 关联的 issue 或 PR。12 个提交给 `anomalyco/opencode`，多与 Go 端点上 MiMo 模型的图像处理和缺失 `x-opencode-session` 头有关。此外还向 `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator`、`iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`、`OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills`、`vercel-labs/skills` 和 `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim` 提交了兼容性问题。向 `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` 提交的 PR 建议收录 asset-inventory。

### 数据说明

窗口内没有缺失数据的日期。2026-09-20 至 2026-10-01 的日期通过 GitHub 搜索重建，数据为近似值：这些日期的星标数不可用，发布信息仅覆盖用户本人的仓库。

highlights.text: 合并的 PR 为 v1.7.0 加入七语种支持、Material 文档站和渲染示例。
v1.13.1 强化了 MCP 探测、明确了 diff 模式的比较范围，并加入三项安全护栏。
合并的 PR 为 v1.4.0 实现文档自动检查并精简 SKILL.md。
v0.4.0 引入 meld.py 命令行，把六个门禁脚本统一到一个 outdir 参数下。
v1.4.0 加入共用的支持代理的原子 JSON 工具和更完整的 agent 发现。
缺陷报告：上下文面板的拆分条中「其他」始终显示为 0%。
缺陷报告：MiMo 模型声明支持图像输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片。
提交 PR 建议把 sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 收录进技能列表。
